question: Which year has the highest average consumer confidence index?
query: To find out which year has the highest average consumer confidence index, you can use the following SQL query: ```sql SELECT DATE::Year AS Year, ROUND(AVG(consumer_confidence_index), 2) AS Avg_Confidence_Index FROM finance_economics_dataset GROUP BY DATE::Year ORDER BY Avg_Confidence_Index DESC LIMIT 50; ``` This query groups the data by year, calculates the average consumer confidence index for each year, sorts the results in descending order of the average index, and limits the output to 50 rows.
